takes.title: Breaststroke with a pronounced frog kick
takes.actionDescription: The performer tips into a face-down swimming posture, sweeps both arms in and forward, and repeatedly bends and opens the legs before extending.

takes.title: Breaststroke with compact arm recovery
takes.actionDescription: The performer comes forward into a horizontal posture and repeats a compact inward arm recovery with a paired leg kick.

takes.title: Breaststroke with a long forward reach
takes.actionDescription: The performer enters the swimming posture from upright, traces broad symmetrical arm pulls, and reaches forward between bent-knee kicks.

takes.title: Breaststroke with repeated head lifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly lifts the head and chest as the elbows draw in, then reaches forward and kicks back into a flatter line.

takes.title: Butterfly stroke with a body wave
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings the arms through broad simultaneous strokes while the body undulates and both legs kick together.

takes.title: Freestyle with alternating arm recovery
takes.actionDescription: The performer rotates through the shoulders in a face-down posture, alternately recovering one arm and reaching forward while the legs continue kicking.

takes.title: Motorcycle stance with raised hands
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds the feet staggered with knees flexed and both hands raised in front as if at handlebars.
